req.title: Task has default completed=false
req.statement: The system shall default the completed field to false when POST /tasks/ omits it.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-016 requires that POST /tasks/ defaults completed=false when the field is omitted. Three test cases are designed: (1) EP positive — omit completed entirely, assert response body has completed==false and status==201; (2) NEG negative — explicitly send completed=true to confirm the field is honoured when present (proving the default only fires on omission, not always); (3) BVA boundary — send a payload with completed explicitly set to false to confirm the schema default and the explicit value agree, and that the response reflects exactly false. Together these kill mutations that: always set completed=true, ignore the default, flip the boolean constant, or change the status code.

import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r016_pos.db')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///./test_r016_pos.db', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_omits_completed_defaults_to_false():
    payload = {"title": "Default completed test", "description": "no completed field"}
    r = client.post('/tasks/', json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body['completed'] == False
    assert body['completed'] is False
    assert body['title'] == 'Default completed test'
    assert isinstance(body['id'], int)
    assert 'created_at' in body

import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r016_bva.db')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from app.database import Base
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

engine = create_engine('sqlite:///./test_r016_bva.db', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_task_explicit_completed_false_matches_default():
    r_explicit = client.post('/tasks/', json={"title": "Explicit false", "completed": False})
    assert r_explicit.status_code == 201
    body_explicit = r_explicit.json()
    assert body_explicit['completed'] == False
    assert body_explicit['completed'] is False

    r_omitted = client.post('/tasks/', json={"title": "Omitted completed"})
    assert r_omitted.status_code == 201
    body_omitted = r_omitted.json()
    assert body_omitted['completed'] == False
    assert body_omitted['completed'] is False

    assert body_explicit['completed'] == body_omitted['completed']
    assert body_explicit['id'] != body_omitted['id']
